_comment: Manual verdicts for DVNA findings the mechanical labeller marked FP. Single labeller (the fixer agent), not blind, not double-labelled. No finding was judged unlisted-real. Entries below only record the reason for the less obvious FPs.

core/authHandler.js:52:express-security/.reason: Re-renders the reset form with req.query.token. A reset link carrying the token in the query string is how the feature is designed; the documented flaw is that the token is md5(login), not the transport. Arguable (morgan('tiny') logs full URLs), but not the documented or an independently proven exploit.

routes/app.js:36:express-security/no-exp.reason: /admin is an authenticated route (authHandler.isAuthenticated); the rule's 'debug endpoint without authentication' claim is wrong for it.

models/index.js:37:security/detect-non-l.reason: readdirSync(__dirname): a fixed directory, no attacker input.

models/index.js:48:security/detect-objec.reason: db[modelName] where modelName comes from Object.keys(db): not attacker-controlled.
